prompt:
UI design mockup of a phone app screen for a model catalogue, portrait, laid out as a typed spec grid on card stock.
Layout top to bottom with scale: (1) a slim brass-ruled header with the app name and icon; (2) filter switches drawn as three labelled oaken toggles, each with its axis name engraved above it and its current value printed beside it, for example 'Likeness - Allowed (24)', 'NSFW - Allowed (20)', 'Native voice - Yes (104)'; (3) the main body: a measured attribute grid on cream card stock, thin ruled lines both ways, column headings in small typed caps with their units - Model, Kind, Context, Licence, Rating - and eight or nine rows of real model names with their values printed in a typed face, alternate rows shaded very faintly; two rows carry a red stamp across the rating column; (4) a slim footer line showing the count 'Showing 66 of 366 models'.
Real content from the app: facet labels "All", "Language", "Image", "Video", "Voice/TTS", "Music", "Text"; filter labels "Likeness", "NSFW", "Native voice" with option text "Allowed (20)", "Open only (6)", "Blocked (21)"; model names "GPT-6 Luna", "Claude Opus 5.5", "Aion 3.5 Mini", "Grok 4.7", "ElevenLabs Music v2", "MiniMax H3 Max". Style: flat vector interface design, oak and brass cabinet framing a warm cream card stock, typed black spec lines, a red rubber stamp for a rating, a blue stamp for a heading, ruled lines, no photograph, no 3D, no glow, no glass.
